alerts_location_id_matches_audience.name: alerts_location_id_matches_audience
alerts_location_id_matches_audience.value: ("alerts"."audience" = 'local' AND "alerts"."location_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("alerts"."audience" = 'all' AND "alerts"."location_id" IS NULL)

credit_notes_number_key.name: credit_notes_number_key
credit_notes_number_key.where: "credit_notes"."number" is not null and "credit_notes"."answer_kind" is distinct from 'rejected'

credit_notes_kept_voucher_check.name: credit_notes_kept_voucher_check
credit_notes_kept_voucher_check.value:
("credit_notes"."reason" = 'orphan') = ("credit_notes"."kept_voucher_type" is not null)
        and ("credit_notes"."kept_voucher_type" is null) = ("credit_notes"."kept_point_of_sale" is null)
        and ("credit_notes"."kept_voucher_type" is null) = ("credit_notes"."kept_number" is null)

credit_notes_request_check.name: credit_notes_request_check
credit_notes_request_check.value:
("credit_notes"."number" is null) = ("credit_notes"."issued_on" is null)
        and ("credit_notes"."number" is null) = ("credit_notes"."requested_at" is null)

credit_notes_answer_request_check.name: credit_notes_answer_request_check
credit_notes_answer_request_check.value: "credit_notes"."answer_kind" is null or "credit_notes"."answer_kind" = 'regularization_required' or "credit_notes"."number" is not null

credit_notes_return_check.name: credit_notes_return_check
credit_notes_return_check.value:
("credit_notes"."reason" = 'sale_return') = ("credit_notes"."return_id" is not null)
        and ("credit_notes"."return_id" is null) = ("credit_notes"."issue_on" is null)

credit_notes_authorization_check.name: credit_notes_authorization_check
credit_notes_authorization_check.value:
coalesce("credit_notes"."answer_kind" = 'authorized', false) = ("credit_notes"."authorization_code" is not null)
        and ("credit_notes"."authorization_code" is null) = ("credit_notes"."authorization_code_due_on" is null)

deferred_sales_expired_time_check.name: deferred_sales_expired_time_check
deferred_sales_expired_time_check.value: ("deferred_sales"."state" = 'expired' and "deferred_sales"."expired_at" is not null) or ("deferred_sales"."state" = 'pending' and "deferred_sales"."expired_at" is null) or "deferred_sales"."state" in ('satisfied', 'cancelled')

discounts_percent_off_has_no_quantities_.name: discounts_percent_off_has_no_quantities_check
discounts_percent_off_has_no_quantities_.value: "discounts"."kind" <> 'PERCENT_OFF' or ("discounts"."buy_qty" is null and "discounts"."pay_qty" is null)

fiscal_requests_authorization_check.name: fiscal_requests_authorization_check
fiscal_requests_authorization_check.value:
coalesce("fiscal_requests"."answer_kind" = 'authorized', false) = ("fiscal_requests"."authorization_code" is not null)
        and ("fiscal_requests"."authorization_code" is null) = ("fiscal_requests"."authorization_code_due_on" is null)

fiscal_requests_rejection_class_check.name: fiscal_requests_rejection_class_check
fiscal_requests_rejection_class_check.value:
coalesce("fiscal_requests"."answer_kind" = 'rejected', false) = ("fiscal_requests"."rejection_class" is not null)
        and "fiscal_requests"."rejection_class" in ('content', 'standing')

fiscal_requests_adoption_check.name: fiscal_requests_adoption_check
fiscal_requests_adoption_check.value:
coalesce("fiscal_requests"."decision" = 'adopted', false) = ("fiscal_requests"."adopted_authorization_code" is not null)
        and ("fiscal_requests"."adopted_authorization_code" is null) = ("fiscal_requests"."adopted_authorization_code_due_on" is null)

fiscal_requests_decision_answer_check.name: fiscal_requests_decision_answer_check
fiscal_requests_decision_answer_check.value: "fiscal_requests"."decision" is null or coalesce("fiscal_requests"."answer_kind" in ('unclear', 'not_attempted'), false)

fiscal_tasks_voucher_check.name: fiscal_tasks_voucher_check
fiscal_tasks_voucher_check.value: ("fiscal_tasks"."kind" = 'deferred_sale_expired' and "fiscal_tasks"."point_of_sale" is null and "fiscal_tasks"."document_type" is null and "fiscal_tasks"."number" is null) or ("fiscal_tasks"."kind" <> 'deferred_sale_expired' and "fiscal_tasks"."point_of_sale" is not null and "fiscal_tasks"."document_type" is not null and ("fiscal_tasks"."number" is not null or "fiscal_tasks"."kind" = 'credit_note_rejected'))

fiscal_tasks_closing_record_check.name: fiscal_tasks_closing_record_check
fiscal_tasks_closing_record_check.value: ("fiscal_tasks"."closed_by" is null) = ("fiscal_tasks"."closing_note" is null) and ("fiscal_tasks"."closed_by" is null or "fiscal_tasks"."state" = 'closed')

lots_exactly_one_origin_check.name: lots_exactly_one_origin_check
lots_exactly_one_origin_check.value: "lots"."technical"::int + ("lots"."purchase_line_id" is not null)::int + ("lots"."origin_movement_id" is not null)::int + ("lots"."assembly_batch_id" is not null)::int = 1

lots_technical_has_no_expiry_or_purchase.name: lots_technical_has_no_expiry_or_purchase_date_check
lots_technical_has_no_expiry_or_purchase.value: not "lots"."technical" or ("lots"."expires_on" is null and "lots"."purchased_on" is null)

offline_fiscal_documents_credit_note_dat.name: offline_fiscal_documents_credit_note_data
offline_fiscal_documents_credit_note_dat.value:
("offline_fiscal_documents"."document_type" = 'credit_note_c') = ("offline_fiscal_documents"."credit_note_id" is not null)
        and ("offline_fiscal_documents"."credit_note_id" is null) = ("offline_fiscal_documents"."corrected_voucher_type" is null)
        and ("offline_fiscal_documents"."credit_note_id" is null) = ("offline_fiscal_documents"."corrected_point_of_sale" is null)
        and ("offline_fiscal_documents"."credit_note_id" is null) = ("offline_fiscal_documents"."corrected_number" is null)

offsite_dump_checks_result_shape_check.name: offsite_dump_checks_result_shape_check
offsite_dump_checks_result_shape_check.value: ("offsite_dump_checks"."status" = 'verified' and "offsite_dump_checks"."size_bytes" is not null and "offsite_dump_checks"."failure_reason" is null) or ("offsite_dump_checks"."status" = 'failed' and "offsite_dump_checks"."failure_reason" = 'shrank' and "offsite_dump_checks"."size_bytes" is not null) or ("offsite_dump_checks"."status" = 'failed' and "offsite_dump_checks"."failure_reason" is not null and "offsite_dump_checks"."failure_reason" <> 'shrank' and "offsite_dump_checks"."size_bytes" is null)

payment_refunds_source_check.name: payment_refunds_source_check
payment_refunds_source_check.value: ("payment_refunds"."origin" = 'late_payment' and "payment_refunds"."payment_id" is null and "payment_refunds"."payment_transaction_id" is not null and "payment_refunds"."origin_event_id" is null) or ("payment_refunds"."origin" in ('sale_cancelled', 'sale_voided', 'return') and "payment_refunds"."payment_id" is not null)

payment_refunds_done_check.name: payment_refunds_done_check
payment_refunds_done_check.value: ("payment_refunds"."done_by" is null) = ("payment_refunds"."done_at" is null) and ("payment_refunds"."state" = 'APPROVED' or "payment_refunds"."done_by" is null)

payment_refunds_discarded_check.name: payment_refunds_discarded_check
payment_refunds_discarded_check.value: ("payment_refunds"."discarded_by" is null) = ("payment_refunds"."discarded_at" is null) and ("payment_refunds"."state" = 'DISCARDED' or "payment_refunds"."discarded_by" is null)

payment_refunds_attempt_confirmed_check.name: payment_refunds_attempt_confirmed_check
payment_refunds_attempt_confirmed_check.value: "payment_refunds"."attempt_key" is null or "payment_refunds"."confirmed_at" is not null

payment_refunds_sent_check.name: payment_refunds_sent_check
payment_refunds_sent_check.value: ("payment_refunds"."sent_at" is null) = ("payment_refunds"."provider_refund_id" is null) and ("payment_refunds"."sent_at" is null or "payment_refunds"."confirmed_at" is not null)

roles_name_unless_administrator.name: roles_name_unless_administrator
roles_name_unless_administrator.value: ("roles"."is_administrator" AND "roles"."name" IS NULL) OR (NOT "roles"."is_administrator" AND "roles"."name" IS NOT NULL)

sale_lines_manual_adjustment_value_check.name: sale_lines_manual_adjustment_value_check
sale_lines_manual_adjustment_value_check.value:
("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_value" IS NULL) = ("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_kind" IS NULL)
        AND (
          "sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_kind" IS NULL
          OR ("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_kind" = 'PRICE' AND "sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_value" >= 0)
          OR ("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_kind" = 'PERCENT' AND "sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
          OR ("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_kind" = 'AMOUNT' AND "sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_value" > 0)
        )

sale_lines_manual_adjustment_reason_chec.name: sale_lines_manual_adjustment_reason_check
sale_lines_manual_adjustment_reason_chec.value:
("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_reason" IS NULL) = ("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_kind" IS NULL)
        AND ("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_reason" IS NULL OR btrim("sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_reason") <> '')

sale_lines_manual_adjustment_authorized_.name: sale_lines_manual_adjustment_authorized_by_check
sale_lines_manual_adjustment_authorized_.value: "sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_authorized_by" IS NULL OR "sale_lines"."manual_adjustment_kind" IS NOT NULL

sales_printed_only_after_attempted_check.name: sales_printed_only_after_attempted_check
sales_printed_only_after_attempted_check.value: "sales"."printed_at" is null or "sales"."print_attempted_at" is not null

sales_credit_note_printed_only_after_att.name: sales_credit_note_printed_only_after_attempted_check
sales_credit_note_printed_only_after_att.value: "sales"."credit_note_printed_at" is null or "sales"."credit_note_print_attempted_at" is not null

sales_deferred_invoice_printed_only_afte.name: sales_deferred_invoice_printed_only_after_attempted_check
sales_deferred_invoice_printed_only_afte.value: "sales"."deferred_invoice_printed_at" is null or "sales"."deferred_invoice_print_attempted_at" is not null

sales_sale_discount_value_check.name: sales_sale_discount_value_check
sales_sale_discount_value_check.value:
("sales"."sale_discount_value" IS NULL) = ("sales"."sale_discount_kind" IS NULL)
        AND (
          "sales"."sale_discount_kind" IS NULL
          OR ("sales"."sale_discount_kind" = 'PERCENT' AND "sales"."sale_discount_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
          OR ("sales"."sale_discount_kind" = 'AMOUNT' AND "sales"."sale_discount_value" > 0)
        )

sales_sale_discount_amount_check.name: sales_sale_discount_amount_check
sales_sale_discount_amount_check.value:
("sales"."sale_discount_amount" IS NULL) = ("sales"."sale_discount_kind" IS NULL)
        AND ("sales"."sale_discount_amount" IS NULL OR "sales"."sale_discount_amount" >= 0)

sales_sale_discount_reason_check.name: sales_sale_discount_reason_check
sales_sale_discount_reason_check.value:
("sales"."sale_discount_reason" IS NULL) = ("sales"."sale_discount_kind" IS NULL)
        AND ("sales"."sale_discount_reason" IS NULL OR btrim("sales"."sale_discount_reason") <> '')

sales_sale_discount_authorized_by_check.name: sales_sale_discount_authorized_by_check
sales_sale_discount_authorized_by_check.value: "sales"."sale_discount_authorized_by" IS NULL OR "sales"."sale_discount_kind" IS NOT NULL

sales_state_matches_timestamps_check.name: sales_state_matches_timestamps_check
sales_state_matches_timestamps_check.value:
("sales"."state" = 'COMPLETED' and "sales"."completed_at" is not null and "sales"."cancelled_at" is null and "sales"."voided_at" is null)
      or ("sales"."state" = 'CANCELLED' and "sales"."cancelled_at" is not null and "sales"."completed_at" is null and "sales"."voided_at" is null)
      or ("sales"."state" = 'VOIDED' and "sales"."completed_at" is not null and "sales"."voided_at" is not null and "sales"."cancelled_at" is null)

supplier_price_lists_source_check.name: supplier_price_lists_source_check
supplier_price_lists_source_check.value: ("supplier_price_lists"."source_kind" = 'PDF' and "supplier_price_lists"."file_name" is not null and "supplier_price_lists"."source_url" is null) or ("supplier_price_lists"."source_kind" = 'WEB_PAGE' and "supplier_price_lists"."source_url" is not null and "supplier_price_lists"."file_name" is null)
